answer: Tie voting power to a costly, slowly earned reputation that decays when peers flag coordinated abuse. A new identity starts at base camp, not the summit: it must complete small, randomly assigned jobs checked by unrelated established agents before its weight grows. Patterns expose fakes — a raven and a falcon may both fly, but dozens of accounts hatching at once, sharing phrasing and funders, flock too visibly to pass as independent, so one operator gains little by multiplying names.
